description: This file defines the FraudDetectorClient class, which is part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides method annotations for interacting with the Amazon Fraud Detector service, including operations for managing detectors, models, rules, and other resources. The class extends AwsClient and acts as a client interface for service calls.

classes.name: FraudDetectorClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with Amazon Fraud Detector service, providing methods for various fraud detection operations.
